description: This Java class defines a rule engine node for filtering messages using scripts written in TBEL or JavaScript within the Thingsboard platform. It initializes a script engine, executes filtering asynchronously on incoming messages, and handles cleanup.

classes.name: TbJsFilterNode
classes.description: A rule node that filters messages based on a script evaluation, supporting TBEL and JavaScript.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the script engine based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Executes the filter asynchronously on incoming messages and routes them based on the result.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by destroying the script engine.
